Watts printed the hymn under Romans 3:19–22. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

19Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God. 20Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin. 21But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, as attested by the Law and the Prophets. 22And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction, ROMANS 3:19–22 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ ROMANS 3
